pins.title: Korea Visa or K-ETA? Start With Your Passport
pins.description: Planning a Korea trip? Start with your passport country, then check your travel purpose, arrival date, age and valid documents. Visa-free entry does not automatically mean K-ETA exemption. Explore Korea Trip Hub and confirm your exact case on the linked official government websites.
pins.alt: Illustrated passport, Korean palace, plane and dotted travel route. Text: Korea visa or K-ETA? Start with your passport. Check your entry requirements. Korea Trip Hub. ktriphub.com.

pins.title: K-ETA for Korea Travel: Check Eligibility and Exemptions
pins.description: Do you need K-ETA for your Korea trip? Check eligibility and current exemptions for your passport and travel dates. K-ETA is not a visa. If required, apply through the official K-ETA website or app and allow enough time before boarding. Korea Trip Hub is an independent travel guide, not an application service.
pins.alt: Illustrated phone checklist, plane and Korean palace. Text: K-ETA for your Korea trip? Check eligibility. Check exemptions. Korea Trip Hub. ktriphub.com.

pins.title: Before You Fly to Korea: Entry Requirements Checklist
pins.description: Before your Korea trip, check your passport, the visa or K-ETA requirements that apply to you, and the latest official notices. Check separately whether you need the e-Arrival Card using the official navigator. Explore Korea Trip Hub for passport-country guides and official links. Entry requirements can change; confirm before travelling.
pins.alt: Illustrated travel document folder, passport, suitcase, plane and Korean mountains. Text: Before you fly to Korea. Passport. Entry requirements. Latest official notices. Korea Trip Hub. ktriphub.com.
